title: Client Contract Momentum Sheet — Q4 2026
content:
Purpose: lightweight, action-first spreadsheet to track contract expiries, expected ARR impact, and the immediate playbook steps per account. This is intended as an ops-first sheet used during weekly renewal huddles and the customer QBR prep flow.

Columns (tab-delimited):
Account	Account Owner	Contract Start	Contract End	ARR (USD)	Renewal Probability (%)	Expected ARR (ARR * Prob)	Next 3 Actions	Last Contact	Risk Flags	Playbook Variant	Notes

Rows:
Acme Robotics	Marcus Lin	2023-11-01	2026-11-30	420,000	65	273,000	1) In-person exec QBR by 2026-10-18; 2) Technical deep-dive on latency SLOs; 3) Commercial propose 12% discount for 24m commit	2026-10-27	delivery-issues, exec-change	enterprise-retention	Client requested real-world latency numbers; procurement lead changing in Nov.

BrightMart (Commerce)	Evelyn Ortega	2024-04-15	2026-12-15	180,000	40	72,000	1) Confirm usage baseline & optimize batching; 2) Offer Optimize credits; 3) Book renewal call 2026-11-10	2026-10-22	mid-size-price-sensitivity	midmarket-expand	Has prototype using dedicated; concerned about cost per session spikes.

DatumAI Labs	Priya Khanna	2022-12-01	2026-12-31	1,200,000	85	1,020,000	1) Run 30-day quality-eval on candidate quantized model; 2) Propose 3% discount for 36m commit; 3) Prepare security compliance attestation	2026-10-29	good-engagement,legal-review	enterprise-retention	Legal asked for updated SOC attestation next week.

EchoHealth Networks	Diego Ramirez	2025-01-05	2026-11-20	320,000	25	80,000	1) Escalate to solutions engineering for private deployment checklist; 2) Present private deployment cost model; 3) Offer pilot extension 2 months	2026-10-11	compliance-constraint	private-deployments	Healthcare data residency concerns — high risk.

Fable Media	Marcus Lin	2024-09-01	2026-10-31	95,000	55	52,250	1) Offer usage smoothing + burst buffer; 2) Share ROI case study for streaming use-case; 3) Set up finance sync 2026-10-20	2026-10-18	seasonal-usage	midmarket-expand	Renewal window tight — CFO out next week.

Ginkgo Logistics	Evelyn Ortega	2023-06-01	2027-01-15	245,000	90	220,500	1) Standard renew, propose 0% change; 2) Offer added routing policy credits; 3) Confirm billing contact	2026-10-30	low-risk	enterprise-retention	High adoption; reference architecture reviewed.

Helios EdTech	Priya Khanna	2024-02-15	2026-12-01	60,000	30	18,000	1) Negotiate term length only (12 vs 24); 2) Provide scaled-down dedicated option; 3) Add renewal pricing FAQ	2026-10-05	cost-sensitivity	midmarket-conserve	Budget cycle ends Dec 15.

IntegraFin	Diego Ramirez	2021-11-20	2026-11-05	2,400,000	95	2,280,000	1) Schedule board-level renewal briefing; 2) Send updated SLA and continuity plan; 3) Prepare red-team audit notes	2026-10-28	strategic-account	enterprise-retention	Procurement already prepared renewal PO draft.

Juno Travel Co.	Marcus Lin	2023-03-01	2026-11-12	75,000	20	15,000	1) Offer phased price increase mitigation; 2) Propose 12-month pilot renewal; 3) Confirm product roadmap fit	2026-09-30	churn-watch	midmarket-conserve	Client exploring competitor pricing.

Kilo Security	Evelyn Ortega	2023-08-01	2026-10-25	510,000	50	255,000	1) Provide encryption/HSM certificate; 2) Book security sync 2026-10-19; 3) Offer 6-month bridge contract	2026-10-15	security-question	security-sensitive	Security team requested proof-of-concept.

Lumina Retail	Priya Khanna	2024-07-01	2026-11-08	130,000	60	78,000	1) Offer volume-based discount tranche; 2) Present consolidated usage report; 3) Schedule exec QBR 2026-11-01	2026-10-26	exec-engaged	midmarket-expand	Retail seasonality — peak usage Nov-Dec.

Monarch AI (PSA)	Diego Ramirez	2025-05-01	2026-12-05	45,000	15	6,750	1) Target upsell with Optimize credits; 2) Push for longer term; 3) Share low-touch renewal template	2026-09-22	low-touch	small-account	Low usage; no immediate renewal momentum.

Operational guidance (bottom sheet):
- Calculation conventions: Expected ARR = numeric(ARR) * numeric(Probability)/100. Use local-currency adjustments in comments.
- Huddle cadence: weekly CS renewal sync (Mon 10:00 PT). Update Last Contact after any substantive touch.
- Escalation matrix: Probability <= 30% & ARR >= 100k -> owner must raise to AM lead for immediate action.
- Playbook variants: enterprise-retention, private-deployments, midmarket-expand, midmarket-conserve, security-sensitive, small-account. Map playbook to the standard playbook checklist in Confluence (linked).
- Quick formulas (for sheet):	Total ARR at-risk (Probability < 50%): =SUMIF(ProbabilityRange,\"<50\",ARRRange)	Quarterly Expected ARR: =SUM(ExpectedARRRange for contracts with Contract End within quarter)

Open questions / to-do:
- Confirm whether Acme Robotics expects a 24-month or 36-month renewal term preference.
- Ask finance to pre-validate discount thresholds for DatumAI and IntegraFin.
- Draft one-pager deal guidance for Kilo Security's POC timeline.

Revision history: 2026-10-05 initial draft by Priya; 2026-10-18 Marcus added Acme notes; 2026-10-27 Evelyn updated BrightMart usage numbers; 2026-11-01 Diego added IntegraFin PO note and edited risk flags.
